errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart, with bars placed side-by-side for each category, not a stacked bar chart where bars are placed on top of each other.

The description fails to state the overall purpose of the chart, which is to compare two different results: '30个模型结果的均值' (Average of 30 model results) and '30个模型的投票结果' (Voting results of 30 models) across 10 experiments, as indicated by the legend.
The y-axis has no units specified. Stating that the unit is percentage is a hallucination.
The visible range of the y-axis is from 60 to 80, not from 0 to 80.

errors.text_span: 图中的每个柱状图由两个部分组成，一个白色区域和一个灰色区域，大小各不相同。
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes a stacked bar chart structure. The chart consists of solid-colored grouped bars (light gray and darker gray), not bars composed of white and gray parts.
The x-axis only contains categories from 1 to 10. There is no 11th bar or group of bars.
For the 4th group, both bars have values above 70 (approximately 70.3 and 75.2). The reported value of 68% is incorrect.
For the 6th group, both bars have values above 70 (approximately 70.5 and 75). The reported value of 64% is incorrect.
For the 8th group, both bars have values above 70 (approximately 70.6 and 74.9). The reported value of 66% is incorrect.
The description fails to explain the grouped nature of the bars and does not describe the two separate data series and their corresponding values for each of the 10 categories on the x-axis.
